title: pvAMReXBoxLibGridReader
body:
## pvAMReXBoxLibGridReader

Reads AMReX/BoxLib plotfiles (directories named like plt00000) into a hierarchical-box (overlapping AMR) dataset of cell-centred grid variables, levels 0 to Level. Listing several plotfile directories in FileNames makes a time series. Use it for AMReX codes such as Castro, Nyx, MAESTROeX or PeleC; use pvAMReXBoxLibParticlesReader for the particles stored in the same plotfiles.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Level defaults to 1, so only the two coarsest levels are loaded; raise it to see the finest data.
- Each FileNames entry is a plotfile directory, not the Header file inside it.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `AMReXBoxLibGridReader`. Identity: `sources/AMReXGridReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellArrayStatus` | Select the cell arrays to read load. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `EnableCaching` | Keep AMR blocks that have already been read in memory, so later updates that change the level or array selection, or revisit a time, do not reread them from disk. It does not change the data produced. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `FileNames` | The list of files to be read by the reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `Level` | This property specifies the desired level of resolution that will be visible. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `PointArrayStatus` | Select the point arrays to read load. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvAMReXBoxLibGridReader",
  "options": {
    "FileNames": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
